name: Backend Probes and Fault Injection
area: Owns backend contract probes, backend fault injectors, and backend-side validation bugs.
audit_basis: Matched queued BUG IDs against regression tests in tests/test_bug*.py.
Included previously merged no-op or patch-only lineage already applied in this workspace thread for BUG-013, BUG-124, BUG-135, and BUG-138.

items.title: `backend_fault_injector.py` has a false-positive hole and omits key fault scenarios
`backend_contract_probe.py` accepts boolean `latency_ms` values as valid integers
Backend validation tools ignore stdout/stderr side effects and can leak secret-bearing output while reporting green or handled results
`backend_contract_probe.py` misclassifies offline and local backend configuration defects because the no-network gate runs after backend construction
